returns.label: return0
returns.description: The Z position (micrometers) of best focus; the stage is left there.

definition.description:
Calibrate the light path of every active detector: its pixel-to-stage transform.

The stage moves `CALIBRATION_STEP_UM` in x only, then in y only, at a fixed focus; the
image shifts give the pixel scale (rotation and flip included), stored per light path
for the frames acquired through it. The stage ends where it started.
definition.name: Calibrate Light Path

children.description: Shared state for affine transformation parameters.
4x4 affine transformation matrix for mapping between coordinate systems
Field of view width in micrometers
Field of view height in micrometers
Hash of the light path configuration this affine matrix corresponds to

definition.description:
Scan a rectangular region of the stage tile by tile.

The region from (start_x, start_y) to (end_x, end_y) (stage micrometres) is covered
with fields of view of the detector (`detector_slot`, else the first active one),
overlapping by `overlap`, visited in `scan_order`; every active detector acquires a
frame at each tile.
definition.name: Scan Region

args.description: Defines the order in which stage positions are visited during acquisition.

choices.label: SNAKE_COL

choices.label: RASTER_ROW
choices.description: Defines the order in which stage positions are visited during acquisition.

choices.label: RASTER_COL
choices.description: Defines the order in which stage positions are visited during acquisition.

args.description: The detector to calculate the FOV for (all other detectors will follow). If None, use the first active detector.

returns.label: return0
returns.description: The frames, in the order acquired.

definition.description:
Acquire a multidimensional dataset: timepoints x positions x z stacks x channels.

Per timepoint the stage visits each position, then each plane of its stacks, and every
stream's detector acquires a frame there; hooks (`m_hooks`, `t_hooks`, `p_hooks`,
`z_hooks`) run at the start, per timepoint, per position and per plane.
definition.name: Acquire Multidimensional Acquisition

children.description: List of timepoints to acquire, each with its own stage positions and hooks
Represents a timepoint in a temporal sequence.
Absolute time to acquire this timepoint (e.g., '2024-01-01T12:00:00') or None to acquire immediately after the previous timepoint
List of stage positions to acquire at this timepoint
Represents a position in 3D space.
Represents a stack of images at different z-slices.
Represents which channels to acquire at each position.
Name or slot of the detector to use for this stream (e.g., 'Camera1' or '1')
Mapping name for this stream (e.g., 'GFP', 'RFP') to be used in file naming and metadata
List of illuminations to use for this stream (e.g., [{'source': 'LED1', 'wavelength': 488, 'intensity': 0.8}])
Represents an illumination channel to acquire.
